title: Make UIAI Engine a great browser for serious work
description: Execute UIAI-COCKPIT-003 sidebar/shell migration first, then the browser reliability backlog, UIAI-COCKPIT-002 agent-first exchange, and UIAI-COCKPIT-004 packaged-runtime/desktop-presentation/Menubar-handoff work in dependency order, preserving UIAI/Focusa authority boundaries and proving each outcome.
design: Authority: docs/UIAI_COCKPIT_DOCUMENT_REGISTER.md; UIAI-COCKPIT-002+C01; UIAI-COCKPIT-003; UIAI-COCKPIT-004+C01; GitHub issues #1/#2. T004 contracts may proceed in parallel, but runtime work waits on browser-pressure recovery, Cockpit shell work waits on T003 rollout, broker integration waits on .6/.7, and final .10 release proof is blocked by .12.
acceptance_criteria: All UIAI-COCKPIT-003 T003-00..T003-19 tasks, UIAI-COCKPIT-004 T004-00..T004-12 tasks, and existing UIAI-COCKPIT-002/browser roadmap children close with linked automated, browser-level, cross-app, accessibility, documentation, compatibility, signed-runtime, and release evidence; no production first-use browser download or closure blocker remains.

title: Fix browser-pressure recovery and land GitHub issue #2
description: Separate current admission pressure from cumulative browser queue/failure history so transient overload cannot poison browser readiness for the process lifetime.
design: Immediate pressure uses active_pages/max_pages and current queue depth only. Lifetime rejection, P95 wait, and fail counters remain under historical_pressure.
acceptance_criteria: Recovered capacity reports browser pressure normal; current queues remain constrained and full pools saturated; historical counters remain unchanged; go test ./..., race tests, vet, docs completeness, API-level regression proof, and remote PR CI pass before closure.
notes: Remote release cycle is authoritative: PR #3 on GitHub is the integration gate; no local release or bead closure before remote proof.

title: Ship origin-bound WebMCP actuation, Cockpit visibility, and release proof
description: Add experimental origin/document/schema-bound WebMCP discovery and invocation, independent postcondition verification, Cockpit progressive disclosure, and the final UIAI Engine Eval/release evidence package.
design: Experimental actuators remain behind capability/policy gates with DOM/AX fallback that cannot expand authority. Final closure requires measured cost per verified and settled outcome.
acceptance_criteria: Origin tools are untrusted candidates invalidated on navigation/removal/schema change; invocation cannot exceed grants or disclosure policy; returned success is independently verified; Cockpit exposes freshness, actuator, influence, verification, watcher and capsule state; all amendment Eval, compatibility, accessibility, token/cost, evidence and release checks pass; remote release proof follows the canonical agent-kb release journal lifecycle (plan, benchmark, progress, problem when needed, exactly one final) with non-empty evidence refs.
notes: Remote canonical release authority: agent-kb-api on knownhost at 127.0.0.1:8791, authenticated journal endpoint /v1/releases/journal; release automation owns production event publication.

title: Implement UIAI-COCKPIT-003 manifest-backed sidebar and shell
description: Pull and integrate the remote UIAI-COCKPIT-003 sidebar amendment: replace Slice 0 primitive navigation with manifest-backed Work/Create/Prove/System IA, Context Control, user preferences, modes, resize, overlay, DnD, route placement, accessibility, entitlement recovery, tests, and rollout before the existing browser roadmap implementation slices.
acceptance_criteria: All T003-00..T003-19 child tasks are complete with contract, accessibility, migration, visual, smoke, and performance evidence; no duplicate Slice 0 shell remains.

title: T003-00 Register amendment and freeze sidebar source map
description: Add UIAI-COCKPIT-003 to the document register and freeze its source precedence against Cockpit 000, 001, 002/C01, entitlement documents, repository contracts, route mounts, parity matrices, smoke harnesses, and current implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Register resolves UIAI-COCKPIT-003; no conflicting document number exists; source map is reviewable.
close_reason: Copied the latest remote UIAI-COCKPIT-003 sidebar specification and added a validated document-register entry.

title: T003-01 Inventory current shell, routes, cards, contracts, and fixtures
description: Record current layout DOM, route tree, Phase 0 card IDs and mappings, package/build commands, and baseline Expanded/Compact/Hidden/Overlay/empty/missing-scope/blocked-entitlement fixtures before replacing Slice 0.
acceptance_criteria: No current component, card, route, or contract is removed without a mapped destination.
close_reason: Added the current-state inventory and test-only baseline fixtures for Expanded, Compact, Hidden, Overlay, empty context, missing scope, and blocked entitlement; npm check and sidebar tests pass.

title: T003-02 Implement workspace and work-object manifests
description: Implement CockpitWorkObject, WorkspaceManifest, subsection manifests, and all first-party Work/Create/Prove/System registry entries with unique IDs, routes, groups, order, object kinds, and capability references.
acceptance_criteria: Registry validation passes and top-level navigation is manifest-generated rather than hard-coded.
close_reason: Manifest-backed workspace registry and footer destinations implemented; sidebar manifest tests pass and all first-party IDs/routes are unique.

title: T003-03 Add SidebarPreferencesV1 schema and migration
description: Add local UserSettings preferences for mode, layout, density, width, collapsed groups, placements, hidden IDs, pinned refs, timestamps, unknown-ID diagnostics, reset, and persistence rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Restart preserves preferences; Local Only works without cloud; invalid preference data migrates safely.
close_reason: Implemented SidebarPreferencesV1 local persistence, legacy v0 migration, width/mode normalization, unknown-workspace diagnostics, reset, and round-trip migration tests.

title: T003-04 Add shared sidebar design tokens and primitives
description: Add sidebar geometry, selection, DnD, resize, badge, overlay, focus, disclosure, tooltip, popover, resize-handle, and empty-state primitives with light/dark/compact/high-contrast/reduced-motion fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Token allowlist passes and sidebar components contain no raw local visual constants.
close_reason: Added semantic sidebar geometry/state/motion tokens and shared row, group, popover, resize, focus, and badge primitives; shell imports and uses the shared classes; checks and tests pass.

title: T003-05 Replace Slice 0 navigator with CockpitShell scaffold
description: Create CockpitShell regions for Unified Toolbar, Primary Sidebar, work-object tabs, viewport, Inspector, and Activity Bar while preserving route slots and isolating workspace failures.
acceptance_criteria: Shell renders from registry and no backend-plane navigation or duplicate shell is introduced.
close_reason: CockpitShell now renders manifest-backed sidebar groups, unified toolbar, route viewport, Activity Bar, and existing real session Inspector boundary; all manifest routes build and shell failures remain route-local.

title: T003-06 Implement guarded Context Control
description: Replace independent scope chips with Project/Workstream/Workpoint context control, expanded context panel, missing/stale/conflict/read-only states, and owning controller/guard actions.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid scope or authority blocks writes with exact recovery and no fictional IDs appear.
close_reason: Context Control now reflects saved project/continuity/Workpoint scope, exposes missing/partial recovery, and browser session open/navigate/close mutations fail closed through scope-guard with exact Settings recovery.

title: T003-07 Implement manifest-backed primary workspace navigation
description: Render Work/Create/Prove/System groups, active routes, subsections, badges, Workspaces menu, hide/restore, group collapse, and fixed Settings/Help footer items.
acceptance_criteria: Every enabled workspace is pointer- and keyboard-reachable with no more than two visible levels.
close_reason: Manifest-backed Work/Create/Prove/System groups, active routes, group disclosure, hide/show/reset controls, workspace menu, and fixed Settings/Help footer are implemented; checks and route build pass.

title: T003-08 Implement Expanded Compact Hidden and Overlay modes
description: Implement 208–320px resize, 64px Compact rail, Hidden mode, constrained-window Overlay, persistence, responsive restoration, View menu and keyboard hooks, focus return, and Escape.
acceptance_criteria: Transitions preserve selection, scroll, groups, badges, and custom ordering.
close_reason: Implemented persisted Expanded/Compact/Hidden modes, keyboard [ toggle, width resize, constrained-window overlay with scrim/Escape/focus-safe close, and state-preserving responsive behavior; checks and fixture tests pass.

title: T003-09 Implement Cockpit-owned sidebar DnD adapter and ordering
description: Select/document a compatible Svelte 5 DnD mechanism and implement adapter-bound within-group/cross-group moves, Favorites, saved-view/work-object pins, keyboard reorder, announcements, transactional persistence, cancel, and rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Section 13 DnD requirements pass and no canonical scope, authority, evidence, or backend state changes.
close_reason: Added Cockpit-owned DnD adapter, presentation-only reorder persistence, HTML drag, touch pointer fallback, Alt+Arrow keyboard reorder, cancel/rollback behavior, and adapter unit coverage; checks/tests pass.

title: T003-10 Integrate Resume Workpoint, Search, and commands
description: Render Resume Workpoint only from real contract state; open the correct Overview/work object; index manifests and registered capabilities; avoid duplicate primary actions.
acceptance_criteria: No fake resume data; Search reaches every enabled workspace and registered capability.

title: Create workspace route skeletons and contextual collection panes
description: Create Section 7 routes and Section 8 secondary navigation, contextual collection pane host, object-tab affiliation, and truthful empty/backend-missing/adapter-missing/gated states.
acceptance_criteria: All routes build and planned workspaces never overstate backend implementation.
close_reason: Added all manifest workspace route skeletons, truthful planned/guarded/current states, and shared secondary-navigation/context panes; frontend checks and tests pass.

title: Migrate Phase 0 cards into Overview Mission Deck
description: Replace the default card grid with Continue, Active now, Recent work, System posture, Suggested next actions, mapped Phase 0 cards, and progressive disclosure.
acceptance_criteria: All 14 cards remain reachable or represented and card grid no longer defines product IA.

title: Integrate Live browser routes and agent-first inspection
description: Integrate sessions, FPV shares, recordings, diagnostics, screenshots, errors, health, current action, agent-first Inspector, capacity/lease posture, and entitlement gating through adapters.
acceptance_criteria: Browser routes are operable and stale/blocked/degraded states are truthful.
close_reason: Shared the real Live browser session surface across /live and legacy /runs; session open/navigation/close mutations use scope guard, with diagnostics, screenshots, health, and truthful states retained.

title: Place Research Studio and Automations routes
description: Wire Research and screenshot/frame routes; represent guarded analysis/design/media/workflow routes with capability state; route long jobs to Activity; preserve omitted agent exposure.
acceptance_criteria: Route parity and Cockpit placement agree; route existence alone never exposes a capability.
close_reason: Research and Studio routes are connected to current real capture/search surfaces; Automations is a manifest-registered planned state with no fabricated jobs, schedules, or agent exposure.

title: Implement Evidence Reports Activity Nodes and Capabilities surfaces
description: Add Evidence saved views, Reports under Evidence, Activity segments/badges, Nodes & Services views, and manifest/card-backed capability catalog with truthful adapter/backend/gating state.
acceptance_criteria: Reports, jobs, approvals, notifications, backend planes, and capabilities appear in their specified surfaces.

title: Integrate entitlement and protected-worker recovery UX
description: Consume canonical entitlement state, capability license/limit metadata, locked/recovery states, recovery-only shell behavior, protected-worker/capsule status, and local-artifact preservation.
acceptance_criteria: No execution allocation precedes entitlement success and no duplicate License workspace is added.

title: Complete sidebar accessibility i18n and interaction contract
description: Add keyboard navigation/reorder, focus management, live regions, drag alternatives, RTL logical properties, message keys, 200% zoom, high contrast, and reduced motion.
acceptance_criteria: Automated/manual accessibility checks pass and no essential operation is drag-only or hover-only.

title: Add sidebar tests smoke visual and performance gates
description: Add manifest/preferences/migration/DnD/badge unit tests, component and route tests, Context/Resume/Activity/entitlement integration tests, all non-happy fixtures, screenshots, performance checks, and cockpit:smoke coverage.
acceptance_criteria: CI-blocking contract, accessibility, visual, smoke, and performance gates pass.

title: Roll out sidebar and remove Slice 0 paths
description: Migrate settings, remove primitive navigator, scope-chip strip, old card-grid home, old process ribbon, temporary flags, dead markup, and update Help/docs/screenshots/release notes/support diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: One production shell remains with no duplicate navigation or dead Slice 0 path.

title: Implement UIAI-COCKPIT-004 desktop presentation and Menubar handoff
description: Implement UIAI-COCKPIT-004: package the Engine-owned browser runtime, present canonical sessions in the single Cockpit shell, and add bidirectional scoped handoff with Focusa Menubar without creating a second browser authority.
design: Authority: UIAI Engine owns runtime/session; Cockpit presents FPV and audited controls; Menubar/Cockpit deep links carry opaque intent only; daemon/Engine truth and distinct app tokens remain canonical.
acceptance_criteria: All T004-00..T004-12 children close with packaged-runtime, same-session, cross-app handoff, broker integration, security, accessibility, compatibility, and signed release evidence; production first-use browser downloads remain zero.

title: T004-00 Register specification and freeze authority map
description: Register UIAI-COCKPIT-004 and C01; update master/register/legacy notice; capture current code and Beads graph.
acceptance_criteria: All references resolve; YAML parses; task IDs and dependencies exist; scheme ownership and authority boundaries are unambiguous.
close_reason: Registered UIAI-COCKPIT-004 and C01, updated master/register/legacy refinement notice, created T004 task graph, validated links/YAML, and proved no dependency cycles.

title: T004-01 Define generated contracts and compatibility manifest
description: Implement shared Go/TypeScript/Rust schemas, route vocabulary, reason codes, protocol versions, fixtures, and compatibility manifest for runtime, presentation, and app handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Identical fixtures parse across Engine, Cockpit, and Menubar; schema parity tests pass; handoff fixtures contain no secrets, raw paths, or private URLs.

title: T004-02 Add browser-runtime provider and production no-download gate
description: Add packaged_cdp, explicit_path, and rod_managed_dev providers, manifest preflight, typed failures, and a production no-download invariant.
acceptance_criteria: Production cannot trigger a Rod download or silently use an installed browser; missing/corrupt/incompatible runtime fails quickly with typed recovery.

title: T004-03 Package sign update and roll back the browser runtime
description: Build platform runtime artifacts and manifests; integrate checksums, signing/notarization, atomic update, compatibility, and rollback into release packaging.
acceptance_criteria: A clean-machine signed install opens a session while browser-download hosts are unavailable; update and rollback preserve a compatible Engine/runtime pair.

title: T004-04 Implement Engine DesktopPresenter and presentation routes
description: Add DesktopPresenter, POST session present, presentation status/ack, idempotency, platform launch adapters, and typed headless/FPV fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Cold and repeated presentation requests converge on one receipt and one canonical session; failures are bounded and typed.

title: T004-05 Implement Cockpit deep-link registration and single-instance routing
description: Register cockpit://, add strict route parsing and single-instance activation, focus the existing window, and select the requested session in /live.
acceptance_criteria: Cold/warm activation opens one Cockpit instance on the opaque requested session; malformed, expired, and unknown links are rejected safely.

title: T004-06 Attach Cockpit Live to existing FPV stream and control
description: Replace screenshot-only inspection with the existing CDP FPV stream, MJPEG/poll fallback, audited input, diagnostics, reconnect, and read-only/takeover states.
acceptance_criteria: Cockpit displays and controls the exact Engine session without a second WebView navigation; fallback and audit tests pass.

title: T004-07 Implement Menubar focusa scheme registration and handlers
description: In the Focusa repository, register focusa:// and implement strict connect/mission/card/workpoint handlers while preserving tray and pairing behavior.
acceptance_criteria: focusa://connect remains governed; mission/card/workpoint routes focus Menubar safely; scheme, parser, signing, and cold/warm activation tests pass.

title: T004-08 Implement bidirectional Cockpit and Menubar handoff
description: Add Cockpit-to-Menubar and Menubar-to-Cockpit controllers, truth-plane fallback, compatibility checks, and sibling-app absent recovery without token sharing.
acceptance_criteria: Both directions work cold/warm; app-absent and version-mismatch recovery is truthful; no authority or token crosses the handoff plane.

title: T004-09 Add Engine and Cockpit lifecycle and local fast channel
description: Make Cockpit and Engine install/launch/update/recover as one product using bounded process management, health handshake, version negotiation, and a per-user socket or named pipe.
acceptance_criteria: One installer launches a healthy product; restart/update recovery does not orphan Engine processes, sessions, sockets, or stale compatibility state.

title: T004-10 Integrate broker ownership leases parking and takeover
description: Bind desktop presentation and Cockpit controls to session ownership, leases, parked restore, expiry, reclamation, and explicit takeover.
acceptance_criteria: Cockpit never bypasses broker authority and truthfully handles owner conflicts, parked/restored/reclaimed sessions, and unavailable capacity.

title: T004-11 Harden security privacy accessibility and degraded UX
description: Fuzz deep-link parsers, scan for secrets, enforce rate/scope/consent guards, and complete keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion, app-missing, mismatch, and reconnect UX.
acceptance_criteria: Security/privacy/accessibility matrices pass; deep links contain only bounded opaque refs; all degraded states provide safe recovery.

title: T004-12 Prove same-session E2E and release readiness
description: Run cold/warm Cockpit activation, Menubar handoff, offline install, runtime preflight, fallback, broker, cross-platform, signing, update, and rollback proof.
acceptance_criteria: All UIAI-COCKPIT-004 unified acceptance criteria pass with stable evidence refs; same-session lineage is proven and production runtime downloads equal zero.

title: Build the Cockpit-002 closure graph and generated contract foundation
description: Turn UIAI-COCKPIT-002-C01 into an executable closure graph with stable schemas, dependencies, tasks, client surfaces, Eval scenarios, migration state, and evidence requirements.
design: Keep one UIAI Capability Registry and consume Focusa generated contracts by immutable version; do not duplicate Focusa operations or authority stores.
acceptance_criteria: All AFB-001..030 entries declare owner, dependencies, implementation bead, client surfaces, Eval scenarios, evidence/receipt requirements, migration and closure state; the ten named schemas resolve to versioned machine-readable contracts; parity/drift checks fail on divergence.

title: Implement shared agent results, response profiles, and bounded discovery parity
description: Implement uiai.agent_result.v1, response-profile negotiation, uiai.agent_client_capability_profile.v1, compact handles, continuation refs, usage accounting, and lazy schema expansion across agent surfaces.
design: Specialized payloads remain typed inside one common envelope; policy may upgrade but never downgrade below risk/evidence requirements.
acceptance_criteria: HTTP, MCP, Pi, and CLI expose contract-parity tests; requested/effective/minimum profiles and upgrade reasons are truthful; compact results preserve recovery, refs, freshness and usage; discovery loads no unrelated schemas; compatibility tests protect existing clients.

title: Implement versioned browser observations and semantic delta/resync
description: Create uiai.browser_observation.v1 with runtime, document, navigation, frame, projection, global-state and element-reference identity plus baseline-bound semantic deltas and full resynchronization.
design: Runtime identifiers are document-scoped and never advertised as durable across replacement. Large projections remain handle-first and budget-bounded.
acceptance_criteria: Observations distinguish runtime identity, locator candidates, and state fingerprints; deltas identify valid baselines; document/frame/projection replacement produces explicit resync states; mandatory semantic dependency closure is preserved; unit, integration, and browser fixtures pass.

title: Bind semantic actions to observations and fail stale work closed
description: Implement uiai.browser_action_request.v2 and revalidate document/navigation/frame identity, target fingerprint, preconditions, obstruction, and consequence state immediately before action.
design: Fallback locators may recover identity only within the same authority and disclosure boundary; fallback never expands action scope.
acceptance_criteria: Changed documents, frames, refs, fingerprints, preconditions or obstruction return stale/resync_required with exact recovery; no stale action side effect occurs; duplicate-side-effect tests, navigation races, modal obstruction, and browser integration tests pass.

title: Add session broker ownership, leases, release, extend, and pool-full guidance
description: Add cooperative ownership and lease metadata to persistent browser sessions with broker inventory, voluntary release, lease extension, expiry, and actionable typed pool-full responses.
design: The existing Rod pool remains the sole browser runtime. Focusa scope is metadata, not authority. Broker state must not become a duplicate task or mission store.
acceptance_criteria: Sessions expose owner/client, Focusa scope metadata, created/last-used, TTL/expiry, priority and safe-close/parkability; expired leases reclaim safely; release and extend are owner-aware; pool-full responses identify wait/reclaim/ask-owner options; race and cross-project visibility tests pass.

title: Implement safe session parking, restoration, and reclamation
description: Complete GitHub issue #1 by allowing parkable sessions to persist bounded resume context, release scarce browser pages, restore safely, and reclaim expired sessions without agents blindly killing one another.
design: Persist the minimum encrypted/redacted resume state needed for recovery; screenshots, diagnostics, cookies, and storage stay behind stable handles and retention policy.
acceptance_criteria: Park releases a page and returns a stable parked snapshot ref; restore reacquires capacity and truthfully reports partial restoration; cookies/storage are never exposed or cross-origin leaked; expired reclaim, unavailable capacity, restore failure, cleanup, and concurrent ownership tests pass.

title: Enforce provenance, influence, egress, and execution capsules
description: Implement browser content provenance/trust classes, influence evaluation, data-class and egress enforcement, and ref-first consequential execution capsules with causality and cleanup attestation.
design: Policy executes outside the model. Provenance dictionaries and manifests are compact; contradictory and tainted sources are preserved rather than silently normalized.
acceptance_criteria: Browser content cannot grant authority or expand tools/egress; prompt-injection and cross-context leakage tests block unsafe influence; consequential actions emit reconstructable capsule refs with before/after observation, policy, actuator, evidence and cleanup state; large artifacts remain handle-first.

title: Add predicate verification probes and bounded settlement watchers
description: Compile Focusa completion predicates into structured browser probes and run server-side bounded, leased, observable settlement watchers with multi-channel and contradictory evidence.
design: UIAI produces verification candidates; Focusa retains completion and settlement authority. Agents are not required to poll repeatedly.
acceptance_criteria: Verification results link predicates, policies, observations, channels, artifacts, contradictions, uncertainty and costs; watchers are read-only by default, cancellable, budgeted and non-authoritative; false-confirmation pages fail; Focusa handoff uses refs without importing raw browser state; browser Eval scenarios pass.
